description: Extends F1a with joint-level PTO efficiency model, seawater density correction, and wave directionality correction. Each joint extracts power; efficiency depends on sea state relative to design.

cwr_design.description: Capture width ratio at design sea state

eta_pto_design.description: Hydraulic PTO efficiency at design sea state (Hs=3m, Te=10s)

cwr_H_s_exponent.description: CWR variation with H_s: CWR(H_s) = cwr_design*(H_s/H_s_design)^exponent; CWR slightly higher at larger waves (more motion)

cwr_T_e_sigma.description: CWR period sensitivity Gaussian sigma [s]; off-design periods reduce CWR

pto_efficiency_H_s_coeff.description: PTO efficiency penalty per m deviation from design H_s: eta_pto = eta_pto_design + coeff*(H_s - H_s_design)

directionality_factor.description: Mean power reduction from wave directionality spread in real seas (attenuator aligned to predominant direction)

source: Henderson (2006) Appl. Ocean Res. 28:297-307; Yemm et al. (2012) Phil. Trans. R. Soc. A 370:365-380 (Pelamis P2); Babarit (2015) RSER 46:291-306.
